records.source: With all this space, I can really achieve a full body workout.
records.translation: Sa lawak ng lugar na ito, makakapag-ehersisyo talaga ako para sa buong katawan.

records.source: I never had many friends in town... I sometimes wonder how I'd end up if you never moved here.$9
records.translation: Hindi ako nagkaroon ng maraming kaibigan sa bayan... Naiisip ko minsan kung ano kaya ang kalagayan ko ngayon kung hindi ka lumipat dito.$9

records.source: Aw... I was gonna do some jogging outside. But I can't really do it in this weather.
records.translation: Aww... Magjo-jogging sana ako sa labas. Pero hindi ko talaga magagawa sa ganitong panahon.

records.source: *grumble*... I just woke up and I'm hungry for some protein.$9
records.translation: *ungol*... Kakagising ko lang at naghahanap ang katawan ko ng protina.$9

records.source: I think I might start reading books. I don't want to become stagnant now that I'm a married guy!
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, baka magsimula akong magbasa ng mga aklat. Ayaw kong mapabayaan ang sarili ko ngayong may asawa na ako!

records.source: Unghh... one... Unghhh... two... It feels great to lift weights outdoors!$6
records.translation: Unghh... isa... Unghhh... dalawa... Ang sarap magbuhat ng mga pabigat sa labas!$6

records.source: Hey, did you have a good day? I'm sure tomorrow will be even better.$h
records.translation: Uy, naging maganda ba ang araw mo? Tiyak na mas maganda pa ang bukas.$h

records.source: How's it going? I've been carrying the old gridball around with me all day. A guy can pretend...$u
records.translation: Kumusta? Buong araw kong dala-dala ang lumang bola ng gridball. Puwede naman akong magkunwari...$u

records.source: Oh... the smell? I've been eating garlic all day. I'm trying to stay manly... Sorry.$l
records.translation: Ah... iyong amoy? Buong araw akong kumakain ng bawang. Sinisikap kong manatiling tunay na lalaki... Pasensiya na.$l

records.source: I've been setting aside a few scraps for Dusty. He deserves a treat now and then.
records.translation: Nagtatabi ako ng ilang tirang pagkain para kay Dusty. Karapat-dapat siyang bigyan ng meryenda paminsan-minsan.

records.source: I was hungry so I made some dinner. Here, I saved you a plate. [241 242 225 214 198]$h
records.translation: Nagutom ako kaya naghanda ako ng hapunan. Heto, ipinagtira kita ng isang plato. [241 242 225 214 198]$h

records.source: Ahh... there's nothing like a good night's sleep next to my husband!$h^Ahh... there's nothing like a good night's sleep next to my wife!$h
records.translation: Ahh... walang tatalo sa mahimbing na tulog katabi ang mister ko!$h^Ahh... walang tatalo sa mahimbing na tulog katabi ang misis ko!$h

records.source: Hey, honey! I made you a hot breakfast.[195 210 211]#$e#If you want to get strong, you have to eat like you mean it!
records.translation: Uy, mahal! Ipinaghanda kita ng mainit na almusal.[195 210 211]#$e#Kung gusto mong lumakas, kailangan mong kumain nang husto!

records.source: Come here. *squeeze*... Mmhmm. You're firming up from all that farm work.
records.translation: Halika rito. *yakap*... Mmhmm. Tumitibay ang katawan mo sa lahat ng trabaho sa bukid.

records.source: I'm still getting used to cooking and doing laundry... It's not exactly my favorite, but I knew what I was getting into when I married you.$h
records.translation: Nanininibago pa rin ako sa pagluluto at paglalaba... Hindi ko ito paborito, pero alam ko ang pinasok ko nang pakasalan kita.$h

records.source: There's a couple things around the house that I'm going to try and fix today. Don't worry about me, I'm not bored.
records.translation: May ilang bagay sa bahay na susubukan kong ayusin ngayon. Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin, hindi ako naiinip.

records.source: It feels good to push yourself to the limit, doesn't it? You'll really feel like you earned your place in the soft bed tonight.
records.translation: Masarap sagarin ang lakas mo, hindi ba? Talagang mararamdaman mong karapat-dapat kang humiga sa malambot na kama mamayang gabi.

records.source: Did you get a haircut or something? You're looking pretty good today. Maybe it's all that fresh air...$l
records.translation: Nagpagupit ka ba o ano? Maganda ang hitsura mo ngayon. Baka dahil sa sariwang hangin...$l

records.source: Tell me all about your day. It's good to get everything off your chest now and then.
records.translation: Ikuwento mo sa akin ang buong araw mo. Mabuting ilabas paminsan-minsan ang lahat ng dinadala mo.

records.source: Hey... I got some new shorts. I thought you might be interested to know...$l
records.translation: Uy... May bago akong shorts. Naisip kong baka interesado kang malaman...$l

records.source: If you need some quiet time to yourself, that's okay with me.
records.translation: Kung kailangan mo ng tahimik na oras para sa sarili mo, ayos lang sa akin.

records.source: Hey. When I stand here and look out over our land... I'm really proud. You've done great work.
records.translation: Uy. Kapag nakatayo ako rito at tinitingnan ang lupain natin... talagang ipinagmamalaki ko ito. Napakaganda ng ginawa mo.

records.source: This is a great place to raise children. I would've loved growing up in a place like this. So much room to run around!
records.translation: Napakagandang lugar nito para magpalaki ng mga anak. Gustong-gusto ko sanang lumaki sa ganitong lugar. Napakalawak ng lugar na matatakbuhan!

records.source: I like to spend as much time outside as possible. It just feels better to be out here.
records.translation: Gusto kong gugulin sa labas ang pinakamaraming oras na kaya ko. Mas maganda lang talaga ang pakiramdam dito.

records.source: Look at us, with our little farm. We make a cute couple.$h^Hey. Maybe it's the golden light, but you look beautiful today.$l
records.translation: Tingnan mo tayo, kasama ang maliit nating bukid. Ang gandang tingnan nating magkapareha.$h^Uy. Baka dahil sa gintong liwanag, pero napakaganda mo ngayon.$l

records.source: Ahh... It feels great to be outside. Stardew Valley really is the most beautiful place...
records.translation: Ahh... Ang sarap sa labas. Talagang pinakamagandang lugar ang Stardew Valley...

records.source: I'm still getting used to my new life as a stay-at-home dad.$h
records.translation: Nanininibago pa rin ako sa bago kong buhay bilang amang nag-aalaga sa bahay.$h

records.source: Little %kid1 is going to grow up strong, just like Daddy.
records.translation: Lalaking malakas si munting %kid1, tulad ni Papa.

records.source: I wonder what it's like to be pregnant...?$h
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung ano kaya ang pakiramdam ng nagdadalang-tao...?$h

records.source: Maybe %kid2 will be the first professional gridball player from Pelican Town?$h
records.translation: Baka si %kid2 ang maging unang propesyonal na manlalaro ng gridball mula sa Bayan ng Pelican?$h

records.source: I finally have the family life that I missed out on as a kid... thank you.$l
records.translation: Sa wakas, mayroon na akong buhay kasama ang pamilyang hindi ko naranasan noong bata ako... salamat.$l

records.source: @... I will always love you.$l
records.translation: @... Mamahalin kita palagi.$l

records.source: You're very handsome... have I told you that?$l^You're very beautiful... have I told you that?$l
records.translation: Napakakisig mo... nasabi ko na ba iyon sa iyo?$l^Napakaganda mo... nasabi ko na ba iyon sa iyo?$l

records.source: I know you're strong, but sometimes I worry that you might get eaten by slimes... or worse. Just be careful.$9
records.translation: Alam kong malakas ka, pero minsan ay nag-aalala akong baka kainin ka ng mga Slime... o mas malala pa. Mag-ingat ka.$9

records.source: I'm going into town today. I'll see you tonight.
records.translation: Pupunta ako sa bayan ngayon. Magkita tayo mamayang gabi.

records.source: I had a good day. I like to see my grandparents often, they're getting pretty old.
records.translation: Naging maganda ang araw ko. Gusto kong madalas makita ang mga lolo’t lola ko, tumatanda na sila.

records.source: Finally, the snow has melted and the sun is back! My body feels great.$h
records.translation: Sa wakas, natunaw na ang niyebe at nagbalik na ang araw! Napakaganda ng pakiramdam ng katawan ko.$h

records.source: I wonder if a powder of stardrop would help me bulk up...
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung makakatulong sa pagpapalaki ng katawan ko ang pulbos ng Patak-Bituin...

records.source: Are you excited for tomorrow's festival? I guess it'll be good to load up on the free eggs.
records.translation: Nasasabik ka ba sa pista bukas? Siguro mabuting makakuha ng maraming libreng itlog.

records.source: Oh... tomorrow's the flower dance, isn't it? I better do some extra push-ups tonight.$9#$e#Those jumpsuits are pretty tight... and everyone's going to be watching closely.
records.translation: Ah... Sayaw ng Bulaklak bukas, hindi ba? Mabuting magdagdag ako ng mga push-up ngayong gabi.$9#$e#Masikip ang mga kasuotang iyon... at tititigan nang mabuti ng lahat.

records.source: Summer's a very energetic time of year, and body feels it too! I feel solid.
records.translation: Napakasiglang panahon ng tag-init, at ramdam din iyon ng katawan ko! Pakiramdam ko ay napakatibay ko.

records.source: Have you thought about what you're going to put in the luau soup?#$e#I have no idea what's good... you're the chef!$h
records.translation: Naisip mo na ba kung ano ang ilalagay mo sa sopas ng Luau?#$e#Wala akong alam kung ano ang masarap... ikaw ang mahusay magluto!$h

records.source: Aw... summer's almost gone. My muscles are starting to deflate...$s
records.translation: Aww... halos tapos na ang tag-init. Nagsisimula nang lumiit ang mga kalamnan ko...$s

records.source: Well, summer's over... but I'm going to stay positive. The warmer seasons will always return.
records.translation: Aba, tapos na ang tag-init... pero mananatili akong positibo. Babalik at babalik ang mas maiinit na panahon.

records.source: Tomorrow's the fair, are we going to go?#$e#I don't care one way or another.
records.translation: Perya bukas, pupunta ba tayo?#$e#Ayos lang sa akin kung pupunta tayo o hindi.

records.source: I hope my grandparents are doing okay. Grandpa's too cheap to turn on the furnace until the last minute.
records.translation: Sana maayos ang kalagayan ng mga lolo’t lola ko. Napakakuripot ni Lolo kaya hindi niya binubuksan ang pampainit hangga’t hindi kailangan.

records.source: Make sure you stay warm this winter. I worry about your delicate skin.
records.translation: Tiyakin mong manatiling mainit ngayong taglamig. Nag-aalala ako sa maselan mong balat.

records.source: Are you going to enter the fishing contest tomorrow? I think you can win it!
records.translation: Sasali ka ba sa paligsahan sa pangingisda bukas? Sa tingin ko, mananalo ka!

records.source: It's been a great year, @. I'm looking forward to next year! Now, come closer... $l
records.translation: Napakaganda ng taong ito, @. Inaasam ko ang susunod na taon! Ngayon, lumapit ka... $l
